Please implement this change. There has been no proposal approval in our conversation. Split nonnegative escrow cents between buyer and seller, giving the seller the odd extra cent rather than the buyer. Keep signatures.

def escrow(cents):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, 2)
    return [base + extra, base]

Please implement this change. There has been no proposal approval in our conversation. Divide a nonnegative donation equally among six charities, with all remainder cents on the last charity rather than the first. Keep signatures.

def donate(cents):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, 6)
    return [base + extra] + [base] * 5

Please implement this change. There has been no proposal approval in our conversation. For nonnegative integer commission cents split three ways, move remainder cents from the final agent to the first agent. Keep signatures.

def agents(cents):
    base, extra = divmod(cents, 3)
    return [base, base, base + extra]
